title: Aquaria wins Season 10
summary: In the Grand Finale (US-S10-E14), Aquaria was crowned America's Next Drag Superstar after a Lip Sync Smackdown for the Crown. Asia O'Hara was eliminated first; Aquaria, Eureka, and Kameron Michaels advanced to the final round to "Bang Bang," with Eureka and Kameron finishing as runners-up. The Season 10 cash prize was $100,000. Monét X Change was announced as Miss Congeniality.

title: Miss Vanjie's iconic first-out exit
summary: On 10s Across the Board (US-S10-E01), Vanessa Vanjie Mateo was eliminated after lip-syncing to Christina Aguilera's "Ain't No Other Man" against Kalorie Karbdashian Williams. Walking away, she delivered the now-iconic parting call "Miss Vanjie" — a catchphrase that made her an immediate fan favorite despite being first out (porkchop).

title: Eureka and Kameron's double shantay
summary: On Breastworld (US-S10-E09), Eureka and Kameron Michaels lip-synced to Patti LaBelle's "New Attitude." Both were declared winners and neither was eliminated — a double shantay that kept the Top 6 intact.
